snippet.title: Mega Man X Regenesis | DOWNLOAD AVAILABLE NOW
snippet.description:
Mega Man X: Regenesis — OUT NOW!

Mega Man X: Regenesis is a free fan game available to download now.

Set in an alternate timeline where Sigma has won and X has fallen, Project Regenesis gives X one final chance to rewrite history.

🕹️ 8 brand-new Mavericks
⚡ New Special Weapons & Armor Upgrades
🔍 Hidden collectibles, secrets & achievements
🎵 25+ original soundtrack pieces
🎨 SNES-inspired pixel art
🎮 Full controller support
💻 PC, Android & Steam Deck
🍎 Mac coming soon

Download and play for FREE:

https://mmxregenesis.itch.io/mega-man-x-regenesis

───────────────────────────────────
Hi Guys, 

I've worked hard for the past 2 something years to complete this fan made game. I had some great help with the art and music from a small group of talented artists. It's not perfect but it's come a long ways. Please give it a try. Join the discord community and you can help me make it even better by reporting bugs, and giving suggestions for future updates and improvements. Hope you like it.

Thanks,
Justin (the developer)
──────────────────────────────────

Join the Community

Discord: https://discord.gg/HXkRNaSWRV

Join the community to follow development, share feedback, report bugs, discuss strategies, and connect with fellow Mega Man X fans.

Credits

Development-
Justin Ross

Music-
JB Sasserman (John Bonham)
